trainer/32201.htm.text: Master Rindy: Welcome to the Kamael Guild. Let me be as straightforward as I can. Why are you here?

trainer/32201-noteach.htm.text: Master Rindy: Don't you know that I can teach only female Kamael Soldiers and Warders? If you expect something from me, I'm afraid that your labor has come to nothing. You'd best seek out someone who can really help you.

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/32201-10.html.text: Master Rindy: Dark Elven Magister Clayton of the Town of Dion knows the important secret concerning our race. Go and see him right now...

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/32201-11.html.text: Master Rindy: Did you find the secret group?

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/32201-12.html.text: Master Rindy: Hmm... I perceive that you already found the secret group and are taking their entrance test even now. Good luck, cadet!

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/32201-05.html.text: Master Rindy: Cadet! You are already a Arbalester! You do not need to test in order to transfer. (Only Kamael Warders can undertake this quest.)

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/32201-06.html.text: Master Rindy: That Inquisitor Mark is the token that proves you have passed the test. Show it to a Grand Master of our race and you can transfer your profession to Arbalester...

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/32201-07.htm.text: Master Rindy: Very well, I will tell you. As you know, Kamael society is organized along military lines. common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
